mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (number, status, user_id, amount, order_time, pay_method, consignee, phone, address, remark, estimated_delivery_time) VALUES (#{number}, #{status}, #{userId}, #{amount}, #{orderTime}, #{payMethod}, #{consignee}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{remark}, #{estimatedDeliveryTime})
mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM orders
AND number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{number}, '%')
AND phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{phone}, '%')
AND status = #{status}
ORDER BY order_time DESC
